card.text: Explore Itokawa in 3D with cssEarth using mission-derived shape and surface data.

introduction.text: Itokawa is a small, two-lobed asteroid visited by Hayabusa. The spacecraft returned samples to Earth in 2010. This view shows elevation derived from the measured shape.

amica.title: AMICA v-band mosaic
amica.summary: Brightness is corrected and matched across three images. Shadows and seams remain; the grid marks gaps and rejected coverage.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 165 m sphere, from the shape model. Colors include the broad form; the outline is simplified.
